purpose: Independent ETTh1 H96 confirmation of the frozen rank-4 MambaACF channel-state mixer factorial.
research_question: Does the frozen channel-state mixer retain its paired and external-baseline gain on ETTh1 without changing any hyperparameter or AutoCon contract?
architecture: MambaACFAutoCon retains one shared temporal Mamba scan, train-only raw-ACF forecast memory, and the prediction-connected AutoCon representation. The treatment adds only LowRankGlobalChannelStateMixer(rank=4): an observed-window-conditioned, shared-hidden-summary FiLM residual with zero-initialized ReZero scale. Forecast and AutoCon consume the same post-mixer state; no dense channel-by-channel matrix or additional Mamba scan is introduced.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory screen. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass can justify an independently registered multi-dataset confirmation only. It does not establish universal superiority, a held-out-test result, a long-horizon result, or speed superiority over DLinear, NLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, or iTransformer.
prelaunch_gates: verify ETTh1 SHA256 fingerprint and 7-channel multivariate contract
verify exact 2x2 mixer-by-relation factorial pairing with fresh seeds
verify MambaACF uses train-only raw ACF memory and a prediction-connected AutoCon representation
verify the rank-4 mixer has a shared-state resource preflight and no extra Mamba scan
verify all external baselines disable candidate-only ACF and relation settings
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

resource_preflight.protocol: 25 warm-up plus 100 device-resident prediction-only forwards on cuda:0; auxiliary representation disabled in both arms
resource_preflight.interpretation: The 453-parameter increase and sub-noise latency difference only clear a no-obvious-regression preflight; they are not a speed-superiority claim.

phases.name: strong_baselines
phases.purpose: Same-budget external references with every candidate-only ACF/relation option disabled.

phases.name: mixer_off_relation_null
phases.purpose: Factorial reference: frozen MambaACF AutoCon graph, mixer disabled, lambda=0 relation null.

phases.name: mixer_off_relation_active
phases.purpose: Exact mixer-off reference with the currently registered lambda=.001 AutoCon relation objective.

phases.name: mixer_on_relation_null
phases.purpose: Exact rank-4 mixer treatment paired to the relation null.

phases.name: mixer_on_relation_active
phases.purpose: Primary candidate: rank-4 shared-state mixer plus the registered lambda=.001 AutoCon relation objective.

primary_contrasts: factorial mixer-by-relation interaction on paired seed MSE
comparison_contract.mixer_activation_gate: Every mixer-on checkpoint must contain a finite nonzero data_dependent_channel_mixer.residual_scale; mixer-off checkpoints must not contain that parameter.
comparison_contract.accuracy_gate: Primary candidate must improve the exact active mixer-off mean, win at least two of three paired seeds, and not exceed the strongest external baseline mean.
comparison_contract.relation_gate: Primary candidate must not be more than 1.0% worse than its exact mixer-on lambda=0 null. A relation-improvement claim additionally requires a lower mean and at least two paired seed wins.
comparison_contract.resource_gate: No extension if exact-shape resource preflight shows material degradation. No speed-superiority wording is allowed from this preflight.

stopping_rules: Do not tune rank, initialization, relation weight, lag resolver, seeds, split, or budget after launch.
Stop this channel-mixer branch before multi-dataset expansion or held-out-test release if the primary candidate misses the exact-control or external-baseline accuracy gate.
Do not claim an AutoCon relation contribution if its non-inferiority gate fails; do not claim it improves accuracy unless its paired improvement gate also passes.
Do not drop or replace an external baseline after launch.
